scoring_justification: Checker rebuilds histograms from the agent's raw cluster-size CSVs and scores structural properties (dimer counts within tolerance, orientation trend, fragmentation) against paper-reported values from Figure 6. Full recompute from raw artifacts is feasible because the CSVs directly encode the cluster distribution.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold dimer counts and unreacted anthracene counts derived from paper Figure 6 and text for 12 km/s shock simulations (a-axis and c-axis).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'the latter simulation produces 49 anthracene dimers (28 carbons) compared to 23 dimers for the c-axis case.' Paper Figure 5/6 context: about 25% reactivity at 12 km/s, ~1260 unreacted 14-carbon clusters for ~1680 molecules. All values from the published paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from paper sentences and figure descriptions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported simulation results, not invented. a-axis: 49 dimers, c-axis: 23 dimers, ~1260 unreacted 14-carbon clusters. Tolerances widened to absorb legitimate re-run variation.

outputs.description: Carbon cluster sizes (number of carbons per connected cluster) identified from the a-axis shock simulation at 12 km/s and 5 ps.
Carbon cluster sizes from the c-axis shock simulation at 12 km/s and 5 ps.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute histograms from these CSVs and compare to hidden gold values from the paper (e.g., 28-carbon dimer count, unreacted 14-carbon count, fragmentation patterns).

dimer_count.description: 28-carbon dimer count within expected range (paper value: 49)

unreacted_count.description: 14-carbon unreacted anthracene count within expected range (paper value: ~1260)

dimer_dominance.description: 28-carbon dimer is the most abundant non-unreacted product peak

fragment_presence.description: Fragments (<14 carbons per cluster) are present in reasonable numbers for a 12 km/s shock

dimer_count.description: 28-carbon dimer count within expected range (paper value: 23)
